$comment: Whether a line says your name, shared by tests/main/mentions.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. Three parts of each client ask this — the notifier, the unread badge and the conversation highlight — and the two clients have to answer identically, or picking up the other device changes what happened while you were away.
$cases: `text` is what somebody said, `nick` is yours, `mentions` is whether it was about you.

cases.name: your name with a colon, the usual way
at the end of a sentence
with an at sign, as people type on other apps
inside a longer word is not you
at the end of a longer word is not you

cases.$comment: IRC nicks may contain []{}\`|^- , so a nick that starts with yours is somebody else
cases.name: another nick that extends yours
and their own name does reach them
a hyphenated bot is not you
an underscore is part of the name too
a nick made of regex characters is matched literally
and does not match something merely similar
a nick with a pipe in it
nobody is mentioned when there is no nick
